220330101.text: Ahh, it would be nice to have some Liyue cuisine...

220330103.text: You are? With that outfit... You're the Traveler, right? Sorry, I'm just a little homesick...

220330118.text: Huh? Could it be... You know how to make Liyue cuisine? That's great!

220330119.text: Th-Then, please help me! Please make me some authentic Liyue dishes!

220330120.text: Let me think... What I really want to eat now is...

220330121.text: I want to eat some snacks. Simple and sweet Liyue snacks.

220330122.text: Recently, when I close my eyes, it's like a dream, I always see a handsome and charming snacks gentleman.

220330123.text: Boots made with scorched rice, a crown made of tofu, clad in a coat adorned with rice buns, and holding a fan made of flower crisps...

220330106.text: Let me introduce myself. I'm Tang Wen, a historian from Liyue. I was previously doing some field research on the unique customs and folklore of Inazuma.

220330107.text: I was about to return to Liyue as I had almost finished collecting information. But because of Inazuma's Sakoku Decree, I ended up being stranded here for a long time...

220330108.text: Actually, I think this is kind of a good thing for me. It's because I feel that this is a historic moment for Inazuma!

220330109.text: I am quite sure that this particular period will certainly leave a strong mark in the annals of history of Teyvat.

220330110.text: To witness such history with one's own eyes, and then record all of it in a true, complete and clear manner for posterity, is what a historian should do.

220330111.text: But... as exciting as this cause is to me, it won't satisfy my stomach...

220330113.text: I can't say... it's because I'm hungry... Hahaha, Inazuma's food is quite tasty too.

220330114.text: I really like the tempura here, although it feels like everything is coated with batter and then fried...

220330115.text: But after eating Inazuma cuisine for a long time, I started to miss the Liyue dishes. Sadly, I couldn't find a restaurant that could make authentic Liyue cuisine.

220330116.text: I finally decided to post a Cuisine Commission at the Adventurers' Guild a few days ago but there hasn't been any response...

220330117.text: Can I give it a try?

220330701.text: So, which snack should we prepare? How about we choose one for her?

220330702.text: Let's see... Paimon's favorite snacks lately are...

220330704.text: Delightful and tasty Lotus Flower Crisp!

220330706.text: Aren't these all your favorite food?

220330707.text: Hehe, just trust in Paimon's taste! Hurry and choose one~

220330709.text: Sounds great! Let's quickly make Rice Buns for Miss Tang Wen!

220330711.text: Yay! Let's quickly make Lotus Flower Crisp for Miss Tang Wen!

220330713.text: Nice! Let's quickly make Tricolor Dango for Miss Tang Wen!

220330715.text: Hmm, let's make the dish for Miss Tang Wen after deciding!

subQuests.subQuestName: Bring the completed dish back to Tang Wen

220330201.text: Back so soon? You're not a secret chef, are you?

220330202.text: Hmmm... I can't wait, please let me try it!

220330205.text: Oh right... Rice Buns, Lotus Flower Crisp, and Tricolor Dango!

220330206.text: Let's decide and give it to Miss Tang Wen!

subQuests.subQuestName: Bring the completed dish back to Tang Wen

220330301.text: Ah! This is it! This, this is the taste of home I've been dreaming of... It's... *sob* I'm so touched...

220330302.text: Thank you so much! I feel energized with all this good food.

220330303.text: These are for you. I wish you a smooth journey ahead!

subQuests.subQuestName: Bring the completed dish back to Tang Wen

220330501.text: Eh? I think this is still an Inazuma dish...

220330502.text: I don't think this is the dish I asked for... Well, never mind, this dish is also filling...

220330503.text: Thanks anyway, Traveler. Please take these.

subQuests.subQuestName: Bring the completed dish back to Tang Wen

220330601.text: Hmm? Why does th—this dish taste... so... so interesting.

220330602.text: Can't say it's interesting... Uhh, I should say...unique, or something...

220330603.text: How did you come up with such a dish? Your cooking skills are really...out of this world...

220330604.text: Thanks for your hard work! Traveler, please take these. I'll umm, savor this dish later...

subQuests.subQuestName: Bring the completed dish back to Tang Wen

220330401.text: Hmm, this taste... well, it doesn't seem to taste like a Liyue or Inazuma dish. The taste is really new to me...

220330402.text: Although it isn't the cuisine I wanted to eat, I'm already satisfied to be able to taste such a novel dish.

220330403.text: Thank you, Traveler. Please accept these.

220330801.text: Ahh, it would be nice to have some Liyue cuisine about now...

220330803.text: Huh, that outfit... You're the Traveler, aren't you? I'm sorry, I'm just feeling a little homesick right now...

220330818.text: Huh? Wait... You know how to make Liyue cuisine? That's great!

220330819.text: Th—Then, please help me! Please make me some authentic Liyue dishes!

220330820.text: Let me think... What I'd really like to eat right now is...

220330821.text: I want to eat some snacks. Simple and sweet Liyue snacks.

220330822.text: Recently, when I close my eyes, I always see a handsome and charming snacks gentleman — it's almost like I'm having a dream

220330823.text: His boots made with scorched rice, his crown made of tofu, he comes clad in a coat adorned with rice buns, holding a fan made of flower crisps...

220330806.text: Ah, right. Allow me to me introduce myself. I'm Tang Wen, a historian from Liyue. Previously, I was doing some field research on the unique customs and folklore of Inazuma.

220330807.text: I'd finished collecting all the material I needed, in fact, and was preparing to head back to Liyue. But so many big things have happened in Inazuma recently...

220330808.text: So I feel like I'm living in historic times here, you know?

220330809.text: The happenings of this particular period will certainly leave a strong mark in the annals of Teyvat's history.

220330810.text: To witness such history with one's own eyes, and then record all of it in a true, complete, and clear manner for posterity — that is what a historian should do.

220330811.text: But... as exciting as this cause is to me, it won't satisfy my stomach...

220330813.text: Well, I wouldn't say that exactly... Inazuma's food is actually pretty tasty.

220330814.text: I really like the tempura here, although it's, well... They just wrap everything in batter and fry it, you know?

220330815.text: But after eating Inazuman cuisine for a long time, I started to miss dishes from back home. Sadly, I couldn't find a restaurant here that could make authentic Liyue cuisine.

220330816.text: So I finally decided to post a "cuisine commission" at the Adventurers' Guild a few days ago, but there hasn't been any response since...

220330817.text: May I give it a try?
